FULL TEXT:
Walk-in Interview
Applications are invited for 04 posts of Research Investigators for the Social Impact
Assessment Project entitled “Social Impact Assessment (SIA) study for acquisition of 429.6565
sq. mts. of land for Construction of Lateral Roads project in Punjab along Indo-Pakistan Border
at villages Dhala (181), Cheena Bidhi Chand (189) and Naushehra (177) falling under Sub
Division Tarn Taran, Teh. & District Tarn Taran (Punjab), under section 4.1 of Right to Fair
Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act
(RFCTLARR)-2013”.
The interested candidates may attend the walk-in-interview before the selection committee,
along with their detailed bio-data and attested copies of educational qualifications, certificates
and work experience, in the office of the undersigned on 30.11.2026 at 10.00 am the office of
the Chairperson, Department of Anthropology, Panjab University, Chandigarh.
Post: Research Investigator: Four posts (04 numbers) for 06 Months only (purely on
hiring/contract basis)
Essential qualifications:
i) M.A/M.Sc. in Anthropology or allied subjects with minimum 55% marks for General category
candidates (50% in case of SC/ST candidates).
ii) The age of candidate should be below 40 years
iii) Knowledge of Punjabi language is must
iv) The candidate/s having fieldwork knowledge in the related subject will be given preference.
Desirable qualifications:
(i) The candidate/s having experience in anthropological Social Impact Assessment (SIA)
studies will be given preference/priority
(ii) The candidate should possess knowledge of fieldwork and must be willing to conduct
independent fieldwork/data collection
Emoluments: Rs. 36,000/- per month (consolidated)
No T.A./D.A. is permissible for appearing in the interview.
Note: Please check the university/department website before appearing for the interviews.
There might be any changes in the interview date and time.
-Sd
Principal Consultant (SIA_Tarn Taran)
Department of Anthropology, Panjab University
Chandigarh-160014
